supervision_proposal: Existing guard live before each job; time -l + tool PTY, one own Cargo, threshold/grant decided by ROOT; no runtime authority in E.
acceptance: Exactly one named test per exact filter must execute. A compile error, empty run, timeout, unrelated failure or snapshot drift is not a semantic kill. Any unmutated failure or surviving required variant stops the affected batch.
